items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Machito with John Henry Lewis, of the Modern Jazz Quartet

ctx.x: Because here someone without your knowledge recorded it, now they have perpetuated Machito with
Charlie Parker live at the Royal Roost, Machito and Howard McGhee, Machito and Harry Belafonte, Machito with John Henry Lewis, of the Modern Jazz Quartet, ahh - Do you feel that it was a good thing?
